web.rs uses it, yes.
**Patch 2 — build() 京畿 replacement:**
old:
```
// 走账铁律 MF#1：consume 销国库侧 + spawn 记接收方——两半同额可核对
let paid = w.material.consume_from_cell("京畿", "库银", spec.cost);
if paid + 1e-9 < spec.cost {
if paid > 0.0 {
w.material.spawn_at("库银", paid, "京畿", None, None, Some("朝廷"));
}
return Err(format!("库银不足：需 {} 实有 {:.1}", spec.cost, paid));
}
```
new:
```
// 走账铁律 MF#1：consume 销国库侧 + spawn 记接收方——两半同额可核对
// MF-18：国库格经 treasury_cell 场景自适应（standard=京畿 / qing=首区）
let treasury = treasury_cell(w);
let paid = w.material.consume_from_cell(&treasury, "库银", spec.cost);
if paid + 1e-9 < spec.cost {
if paid > 0.0 {
w.material.spawn_at("库银", paid, &treasury, None, None, Some("朝廷"));
}
return Err(format!("库银不足：需 {} 实有 {:.1}", spec.cost, paid));
}
```
And ledger line: `"BUILD {building_id}@{cell} 银={:.2}（Transfer 国库@京畿→营造银@{cell}，两半同额走账）"` → `（Transfer 国库@{treasury}→营造银@{cell}，两半同额走账）`.
**Patch 3 — grain_gift:**
```
w.material.spawn_at("库银", 300.0, "京畿", None, None, Some("天命"));
w.material.ledger.push("SPAWN 库银@京畿 n=300 owner=天命（词条：点石成金）".into());
```
→
```
let treasury = treasury_cell(w);
w.material.spawn_at("库银", 300.0, &treasury, None, None, Some("天命"));
w.material.ledger.push(format!(
"SPAWN 库银@{treasury} n=300 owner=天命（词条：点石成金）"));
```
**Patch 4 — recruit:**
```
let aid = w.entities.spawn("代理人", Some("京畿"), None);
```
→ `let home = treasury_cell(w);` then spawn with Some(&home); and `e.ctx.insert("region".into(), "京畿".into());` → home.clone(). Block:
```
"recruit" => {
let aid = w.entities.spawn("代理人", Some("京畿"), None);
if let Some(e) = w.entities.get_mut(&aid) {
e.fields.insert("操守".into(), 0.95);
e.fields.insert("带宽".into(), 0.9);
